summaries.senate: The biggest moves in the Senate came in [[Kansas]] and [[Maine]], where the Democrats Adam Hamilton and Troy Jackson each gained sharp ground in the Polymarket odds, and the market now counts both as predicted flips. Elsewhere, Julia Letlow's chances in [[Louisiana]] took a sizable drop, and Ashley Hinson saw a similarly sizable slip in Iowa.
summaries.governor: The Republican candidate's chances took a sizable drop in the Polymarket odds for [[Kansas]], where Ty Masterson is the leader and the market sees a predicted flip. Another sizable fall came in [[Texas]], where Greg Abbott's chances declined against the Democrat Gina Hinojosa. In [[Vermont]], the market also showed a sizable decline for the Republican Phil Scott.
summaries.house: The Democrats' chances of winning control of the House edged up slightly, according to Polymarket odds. In [[NC-13 (Fuquay-Varina & Sanford)]], the Republican Brad Knott saw a sharp gain in their chances. In [[NY-17 (Spring Valley & Ossining)]], a predicted flip, the Democrat Cait Conley slipped by a sizable amount, as did the Republican French Hill in [[AR-02 (Little Rock & Conway)]].
